early.name: Stalker
early.annotation: Great damage and stats in lane and gives you move speed for chasing. The foostep sound reduction is also nice. And this gives you wallhacks from the DoT. This is also for the weapon investment bonus.

mid.name: Torment Pulse
mid.annotation: Great damage over the course of a game/fight. And makes you a little tankier. Also helps with farming. Just super good core item for us.

mid.name: Lifestrike
mid.annotation: Tons of healing from your 2 and melees. Keeps you alive in fights. It's 200+ health heal on a 4 sec CD.

mid.name: Point Blank
mid.annotation: Possible option for hitting 4.8k weapon investment. Feels pretty good.

mid.name: Spirit Snatch
mid.annotation: Spirit resist and power steal is amazing. Plus even more melee damage and it procs on your 2.

late.name: Arctic Blast
late.annotation: Really great item, great for catching people and for clearing waves in cat form. The combo with it is Arctic Blast, 2 immediately so the AB travels with you, light punch, 1, 4.

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: Great item once you have 2 actives. It also makes Torment Pulse tick faster! Very good with Ethereal Shift in particular.

late.name: Escalating Exposure
late.annotation: This with Scourge is insane. You run into the middle of the enemy team with Scourge and they take like 2-4k damage. Also has shred and gives you even more spirit resist so you're even tankier.

late.name: Scourge
late.annotation: Usually after Arctic Blast. Makes you really tanky and can do a lot of damage if you get into the middle of their team. You can rush earlier if you feel it would be good or have the money.

late.name: Spirit Burn
late.annotation: Anti-heal + more burst damage. If you need to burst carries this is really useful.

late.name: Colossus
late.annotation: Extra resists and health is great. Also works as an alternative upgrade for Extra Health.

late.name: Ethereal Shift
late.annotation: They doubled the CD on it so it's way worse, still might be good though on Calico. Helps you live much longer. Great with Transcendent CD. You can skip for more damage if you're not dying.

late.name: Juggernaut
late.annotation: Great against gun carries and is good to pick up if you have no free slots.

late.name: Spellbreaker
late.annotation: Incredible against Lash, Grey Talon, and any other spirit burst characters.

968099481.annotation: Upgrades into Improved Spirit. Good for damage on bombs.

7409189.annotation: Great for damage in lane on your bombs. The regen it gives is also nice. With T2 bombs this gets them to over 80 damage which will proc Mystic Burst.

380806748.annotation: More uptime on your ult means more fights you can take.

2081037738.annotation: Upgrades into Escalating Exposure. Spirit shred is extremely useful.

2519598785.annotation: Gives you some much needed damage in the late game with your ult and gloom bombs. Great if you are trying to oneshot their carries.

1998374645.annotation: Decent for poke in lane after your bombs do 80+ damage. Also procs on Cold Front! You can upgrade to Tankbuster later after Arctic Blast.

1009965641.annotation: Great if enemies are pushing to your tower or you need to push and take objectives.

4204808176.annotation: Great against Viscous in lane since it works against Viscous Puddle Punches. Also a very good item against people building melee (Abrams and Billy). Only buy if you can actually parry consistently.

3585132399.annotation: Gets you your 4.8k vitality investment. Or go Veilwalker/Lifestrike here. The health is great for survivability, the move speed is great for rotating, and the heal lets you stay on the map longer.

2163598980.annotation: If you need anti-spirit. Very common buy although not absolutely necessary since we build many items that have spirit resist already.

3140772621.annotation: For bullet resist. If it's early, probably just go Battle Vest instead though. If it's late and you've got Transcendent Cooldown I would just go Metal Skin instead.

865958998.annotation: Alternative to Fortitude. Really nice for rotating around the map, ganking, escaping/survivability, and the heal is great.

3970837787.annotation: Great for more spirit resist early. Cooldown reduction is really rare so this is a great item since it gives you some.

112198670.annotation: Great against spirit damage. You can get in some lanes.

1235347618.annotation: Good item at the moment, the bullet resist and regen is great in lane. Later though you should just get Bullet Resilience. Also good for farming denizens.

619484391.annotation: Good item. Very common buy. Silence is very good against many characters and since it's an AoE it can hit many people in a teamfight.

1925087134.annotation: Great at stopping gun carries. Easy to proc and can proc on many people.

1813726886.annotation: Good against Mina, and other movement focused people.

1219329868.annotation: Builds into Focus Lens, easy to use and great for 1v1s. Makes your burst way stronger.

3403085434.annotation: With great flinching comes great responsibility

2142980412.annotation: Quite strong at the moment, shred is good.

2121044373.annotation: ONLY GET AFTER ARCTIC BLAST. Tankbuster tool tip lies and it actually procs with items such as Arctic Blast. Decent for more burst damage but I don't like it much.

1371725689.annotation: Good for shutting down fliers and gun carries. And for getting on top of the people you need to target in team fights.

3491236900.annotation: Great but usually only buy once you already have bullet resist. Great against Haze.

3028234315.annotation: Kind of a meme item. Very situational. Only get against lots of incremental spirit damage (McGinnis turrets, Infernus, Warden Ult) and have Spirit Resilience already.

3270001687.annotation: Good for movement and the bullet resist is nice.

334300056.annotation: fun item, good value, mmm mmmmovement. You could buy this in the mid game some time rather than getting resists perhaps.

2617435668.annotation: If you really need to screw over someone in particular.

2947183272.annotation: Kind of fun, but not very good. Adds up to a decent amount of heal in longer fights since Torment Pulse and Scourge easily procs it.

2800629741.annotation: Fun and silly! Also good escape tool. Just worse to get than other 6ks though.

1292979587.annotation: It's nice on your bombs. You like all the things it gives you. But before you get Arctic Blast, the bombs are inconsistent to hit, and your bombs don't have that good spirit scaling.

1254091416.annotation: If no one else on your team is going to buy this and you really need to stop a Vindicta/GT or Seven ult.

3144988365.annotation: I don't think this is really all that worth it compared to just getting Healbane. Since any person incredibly reliant on healing will just get Debuff Remover. But maybe get against Mo or Abrams.

1102081447.annotation: Just feels really nice, makes it super easy to hit your ults second/end damage burst. Probably also nice against like Vyper.

3361811174.annotation: If you are actually like the only player on your team doing anything and you have like 65k souls you could get this.

3074274290.annotation: DO NOT EVER BUILD THIS UNLESS YOU ARE 100% SURE YOU WILL GET LOTS OF STACKS. This is often a trap item, which puts you -3k souls down, without giving you anything much in return until later.

1378931225.annotation: This since it got buffed is actually kinda really good against some characters, especially Haze and Drifter. I'd get this as an alternative to Bullet Resilience or Plated Armor.

2059712766.annotation: Really nice for the stamina. Healing got a big nerf so is meh now. Decent to pick up for general survivability.

3361075077.annotation: Decent item against certain gun carries.

805079544.annotation: It's nice, but I just prefer to go Return Fire or Suppressor or rush Bullet Resilience early.

2829638276.annotation: Worse than the other lane healing items imo. Plus if you're getting Lifestrike it's useless.

2095565695.annotation: Possible option for hitting 4.8k weapon investment. Feels pretty good.

709540378.annotation: Possible item for your 4.8k Weapon Investment, but imo it's not that necessary on Calico.

3294954488.annotation: Seems fun but probably not good lol. Would probably put on 4 or 1.

26002154.annotation: Melee damage is really fun. We upgrade this into Crushing Fists.

1342610602.annotation: Can get earlier, not sure where you'd fit it in though.

1414319208.annotation: Great for damage and bullet resist. Super core item for your weapon damage.

800008313.annotation: Big powerspike. You can rush earlier if you are doing well. If you aren't having success with melee you could skip this and go into more of a spirit build.

3884003354.annotation: One of the best damage items in the game because of the shred. The anti-heal is also amazing.

3577481646.annotation: IF they will make it so Reverb works with Slash, that's because of me

2061878743.annotation: You are behind teammates and enemy has gunners

3977876567.annotation: Amazing for ammo since it gives a flat amount rather than a percentage. Helps for pushing objectives.

1396247347.annotation: Great damage, you could also go Crippling Headshot or something else here.

1770441818.annotation: Easy to proc. Increases yours and your teams damage. Upgrades to Crippling Headshot which is great in the late game.

865846625.annotation: Stay alive more, nice for hybrid builds.

1113837674.annotation: Can be good for shutting down ability reliant characters.

1662311306.annotation: Can remove ult debuffs such as Pocket ult. Prioritise casting it on other people though since half the CD gets refunded.

1955841979.annotation: Incredible against Lash, Grey Talon, and any other spirit burst characters.

1250307611.annotation: Great against gun carries and is good to pick up if you have no free slots.

968099481.annotation: Upgrades into Improved Spirit. Good for damage on bombs.

7409189.annotation: Great for damage in lane on your bombs. The regen it gives is also nice. With T2 bombs this gets them to over 80 damage which will proc Mystic Burst.

380806748.annotation: More uptime on your ult means more fights you can take.

2081037738.annotation: Upgrades into Escalating Exposure. Spirit shred is extremely useful.

2519598785.annotation: Gives you some much needed damage in the late game with your ult and gloom bombs. Great if you are trying to oneshot their carries.

1998374645.annotation: Decent for poke in lane after your bombs do 80+ damage. Also procs on Cold Front! You can upgrade to Tankbuster later after Arctic Blast.

1009965641.annotation: Great if enemies are pushing to your tower or you need to push and take objectives.

4204808176.annotation: Great against Viscous in lane since it works against Viscous Puddle Punches. Also a very good item against people building melee (Abrams and Billy). Only buy if you can actually parry consistently.

3585132399.annotation: Gets you your 4.8k vitality investment. Or go Veilwalker/Lifestrike here. The health is great for survivability, the move speed is great for rotating, and the heal lets you stay on the map longer.

2163598980.annotation: If you need anti-spirit. Very common buy although not absolutely necessary since we build many items that have spirit resist already.

3140772621.annotation: For bullet resist. If it's early, probably just go Battle Vest instead though. If it's late and you've got Transcendent Cooldown I would just go Metal Skin instead.

865958998.annotation: Alternative to Fortitude. Really nice for rotating around the map, ganking, escaping/survivability, and the heal is great.

3970837787.annotation: Great for more spirit resist early. Cooldown reduction is really rare so this is a great item since it gives you some.

112198670.annotation: Great against spirit damage. You can get in some lanes.

1235347618.annotation: Good item at the moment, the bullet resist and regen is great in lane. Later though you should just get Bullet Resilience. Also good for farming denizens.

619484391.annotation: Good item. Very common buy. Silence is very good against many characters and since it's an AoE it can hit many people in a teamfight.

1925087134.annotation: Great at stopping gun carries. Easy to proc and can proc on many people.

1813726886.annotation: Good against Mina, and other movement focused people.

1219329868.annotation: Builds into Focus Lens, easy to use and great for 1v1s. Makes your burst way stronger.

3403085434.annotation: With great flinching comes great responsibility

2142980412.annotation: Quite strong at the moment, shred is good.

2121044373.annotation: ONLY GET AFTER ARCTIC BLAST. Tankbuster tool tip lies and it actually procs with items such as Arctic Blast. Decent for more burst damage but I don't like it much.

1371725689.annotation: Good for shutting down fliers and gun carries. And for getting on top of the people you need to target in team fights.

3491236900.annotation: Great but usually only buy once you already have bullet resist. Great against Haze.

3028234315.annotation: Kind of a meme item. Very situational. Only get against lots of incremental spirit damage (McGinnis turrets, Infernus, Warden Ult) and have Spirit Resilience already.

3270001687.annotation: Good for movement and the bullet resist is nice.

334300056.annotation: fun item, good value, mmm mmmmovement. You could buy this in the mid game some time rather than getting resists perhaps.

2617435668.annotation: If you really need to screw over someone in particular.

2947183272.annotation: Kind of fun, but not very good. Adds up to a decent amount of heal in longer fights since Torment Pulse and Scourge easily procs it.

2800629741.annotation: Fun and silly! Also good escape tool. Just worse to get than other 6ks though.

1292979587.annotation: It's nice on your bombs. You like all the things it gives you. But before you get Arctic Blast, the bombs are inconsistent to hit, and your bombs don't have that good spirit scaling.

1254091416.annotation: If no one else on your team is going to buy this and you really need to stop a Vindicta/GT or Seven ult.

3144988365.annotation: I don't think this is really all that worth it compared to just getting Healbane. Since any person incredibly reliant on healing will just get Debuff Remover. But maybe get against Mo or Abrams.

1102081447.annotation: Just feels really nice, makes it super easy to hit your ults second/end damage burst. Probably also nice against like Vyper.

3361811174.annotation: If you are actually like the only player on your team doing anything and you have like 65k souls you could get this.

3074274290.annotation: DO NOT EVER BUILD THIS UNLESS YOU ARE 100% SURE YOU WILL GET LOTS OF STACKS. This is often a trap item, which puts you -3k souls down, without giving you anything much in return until later.

1378931225.annotation: This since it got buffed is actually kinda really good against some characters, especially Haze and Drifter. I'd get this as an alternative to Bullet Resilience or Plated Armor.

3361075077.annotation: Decent item against certain gun carries.

805079544.annotation: It's nice, but I just prefer to go Return Fire or Suppressor or rush Bullet Resilience early.
